sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def tile(f,r0,c0):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(tuple(1 if L[r][c]=='B' else 0 for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def tr(s):
    t=[]
    for i in range(8):
        a=s
        for _ in range(i%4): a=tuple(tuple(a[r][4-c] for c in range(5)) for r in range(5))
        b=a if i<4 else tuple(a[4-r] for r in range(5))
        t.append(b)
    return t
topc=[(5+9*i,c) for i in range(3) for c in (13,23,36,46)]
palette=[tile(current_frame,r,c) for r,c in topc]
blue=[tile(current_frame,41,15+7*j) for j in range(5)]
def classify(sym):
    for k,p in enumerate(palette):
        if sym in tr(p): return 'T%d'%k
    for k,p in enumerate(blue):
        if sym in tr(p): return 'B%d'%k
    return '?'
def pink4(): return tile(current_frame,52,43)
seq=[classify(pink4())]
for i in range(7):
    action(['UP'])
    seq.append(classify(pink4()))
print("slot4 cycle (start + 7 UPs):",seq)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
